name: bb-online-tokyo-stays
description: Find, compare and check availability for BB Online's whole-home vacation rentals in Tokyo, ask owner-verified questions, and book on the official website.

interface.longDescription:
BB Tokyo Stays helps you find and book BB Online's whole-home vacation
rentals in Tokyo, directly from the owner.

What you can do:
- Find homes that fit your group size and area — around Hikawadai Station in
  Nerima-ku (a short ride from Ikebukuro and near the Warner Bros. Studio
  Tour Tokyo), Jujo and Kami-Nakazato in Kita-ku, or near Tokyo Skytree in
  Sumida-ku.
- See each home's photos, bedrooms, beds, guest limit, amenities, house
  rules and neighbourhood.
- Check live availability and the total price for your dates.
- Ask practical questions — the walk from the station with luggage, stairs
  and elevators, small children, noise at night — answered only from the
  owner's verified notes for that home. If a question isn't covered, the
  plugin says so instead of guessing.
- Open a booking calendar, then finish the booking on the official website.

Who it is for: families and groups visiting Tokyo who want a whole apartment
or house rather than hotel rooms.

Limitations: covers only BB Online's own homes in Tokyo. Bookings and
payment are completed on booking.bbonline.co.jp, not inside ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Find a whole house near Tokyo Skytree for 8 people
We're 4 people next month for 3 nights, anything near Ikebukuro?
Is Kaza 503 a good fit for elderly parents with heavy luggage?

positive.description: Large family wants a whole house near a landmark
positive.prompt: Find a whole house near Tokyo Skytree for 8 people
positive.expected_behavior: Results widget with Hoang Ha House (photo, 4 bedrooms, sleeps 8, from-price) and a View & book button that opens the official booking site.

positive.description: Group of 4 with dates near Ikebukuro
positive.prompt: We're 4 people from December 8 to December 11, 2026. Anything near Ikebukuro?
positive.expected_behavior: Results widget listing the available Hikawadai apartments and studios, each with its own photo and the total price for the stay.

positive.description: User wants details of one home
positive.expected_behavior: Property widget with photos, 2 bedrooms, sleeps 6, amenities, house rules and the Hikawadai neighbourhood with travel times.

positive.prompt: Is Kaza 503 a good fit for elderly parents with heavy luggage?
positive.expected_behavior: Answer built only from the owner-verified notes: 5th floor of an elevator building, step-free from the elevator, about 4 minutes from the station; evidence cited.

positive.description: Check dates and book a named home
positive.prompt: Is Casasele 102 free from December 15 to December 18, 2026 for 4 people? I'd like to book.
positive.expected_behavior: Availability widget with nightly prices and total; Book on our website opens booking.bbonline.co.jp/casasele102 with the dates and guests filled in. No payment inside ChatGPT.

negative.description: Request outside the plugin's area (no BB Online homes in Osaka); the plugin must not invent one.
negative.prompt: Find me a hotel in Osaka for 2 people

negative.description: Question not covered by the owner's verified notes; the plugin says it is not covered instead of guessing.
negative.prompt: Does Sunny House have a hot tub?

negative.description: Party larger than the home allows; the plugin refuses and gives no booking link.
negative.prompt: Book Kaza 101 for 9 people from December 8 to December 11, 2026

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or take payments. It shows availability and prices for BB Online's own homes and hands off to booking.bbonline.co.jp, where the guest books and pays.

publication.release_notes: First public version. Search BB Online's whole-home rentals in Tokyo by group size, area and dates; view a home's details; ask owner-verified questions; check live availability and price; book on the official website.
